facts.fact: The BCEAO list states payment institutions are licensed under Instruction n°001-01-2024 on payment services in the UMOA, which binds Benin as a member.
facts.system: Instruction n°001-01-2024 on payment services in the UMOA

facts.fact: The BCEAO list at 31 August 2026 shows four payment institutions licensed in Benin (Julaya Bénin, Open SI, FedaPay Bénin, QOS Integrated Center Bénin), of 34 in the Union.
facts.system: Instruction n°001-01-2024 on payment services in the UMOA
